name: Restoration ng lumang Kapilya
desc: Restore the leaky roof and whitewash the walls of the historic barrio chapel so the community can gather and celebrate weddings.
reward: Unlocks wedding ceremonies and chapel choir blessing events.

name: Kumpuni ng Tulay sa Ilog
desc: Reinforce the old wooden bridge crossing Maliwanag River, securing the path for trade carts and creating a scenic sunset promenade.
reward: Unlocks the romantic riverside walking path and date spot.

name: Pintura at Ring ng Basketbolan
desc: Resurface the cracked concrete court, install new fiberglass backboards and solar lights for the barrio youth league.
reward: Unlocks evening community games and boost friendship with youth.

name: Pagpapalawak ng Bahay sa Bukid
desc: Add a spacious master bedroom, nursery room, and polished mahogany wood floors to welcome a spouse and children.
reward: Unlocks marriage proposal, spouse move-in, and raising up to 2 children.
